Warehousing

पुनः स्टॉक अलर्ट

A system-generated notification indicating inventory has reached the predefined reorder threshold and requires replenishment, as set in WMS or ERP platforms and reflected in inventory management documentation.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A system-generated notification indicating inventory has reached the predefined reorder threshold and requires replenishment, as set in WMS or ERP platforms and reflected in inventory management documentation.

Operational example

A restock alert is triggered automatically when on-hand inventory drops below the reorder point established in the WMS settings.

Localized term
